warm up and first qualifying laps
priming your tires for the White Flag
while you want to carry as much speed as

you don't want to scrub them so as long
as you're making your way through the

four roll up to the top and give

lap fire the car into turn one lean on
the brakes try to hook the left front on
the yellow line through the center give
it a few burps to get the nose planted
before you throttle out of the corner
run down the backstretch and hit turns

finish your

as far as the race is concerned this
track is about as simple as it gets
starting the race in second gear you
want to minimize Tire scrub by using the
full width of the track running against
the walls in the straightaways backing
up your entries and Diving down to the
yellow line in the corners don't let the
car track up too early as squaring off
your exits will be an easy way to junk
your
tires if you find yourself in a position
where you're racing in traffic you'll
want to prioritize picking the lane with
the strongest cars the second lane can
work if you have clean air the moment a
slower car occupies that space you'll be
better off taking the inside regardless
of how congested it may be while being
quick would be helpful biggest deciding
factor at this track will be your
self-preservation as easy as it is to
blame everybody else when things go
wrong the responsibility of minimizing
the damage Falls solely on you so keep
an eye on your mirror check everybody's
connection on the entry page before you
get in the car and keep an eye out for
familiar names to follow or avoid
depending on their reputation if you can
avoid the RS keep your tires under you
keep the car planted on the bottom
through the corners you'll find yourself
in contention for the win as the laps
wind down good luck
